title: Address
description: A ready-made name for this server, with one certificate for everything under it. You ask for one and someone approves it. After that, this server's only call home is a daily check, carrying nothing else. Turn it off by releasing it here.

problem.unreachable: The last daily check did not get through. Names already issued keep working, and it tries again.
problem.lost: The service no longer knows this server, so names under this address stopped resolving. Release it, then ask for a new one.
problem.disabled: This address was disabled by the service's operator. Release it to go back to generated names, then ask for a new one if you need it.

certificateHint.issued: One certificate serves every name under this address.
certificateHint.expiring: It will be renewed by the proxy on its own.
certificateHint.expired: The proxy could not renew it. Check its logs.
certificateHint.pending: The proxy asks for it as soon as it starts, which can take a few minutes.

releaseDescription: Its records are removed for good and the name is never issued again. Generated names go back to sslip.io, and this server stops calling the service.
emptyDescription: Generated names use sslip.io. Ask for an address to give this server its own name and one certificate for everything under it.
emptyDescriptionOff: This server is set to never call the address service, so generated names use sslip.io.
refusedNote: The last request was refused. You can ask again, or keep using generated names and your own domains.

requestForm.title: Ask for an address
requestForm.description: Someone reads each request before a name is issued. Once it is approved, this server moves to its address by itself.
requestForm.emailHint: Only used to reach you about this address.
requestForm.purpose: What will you use it for?
requestForm.purposeInvalid: Say in a few words what you will use it for, in 500 characters at most.

waiting.hint: Someone reads each request. Once this one is approved, this server moves to the address by itself, and the panel also answers at {{panel}}.
waiting.withdrawDescription: The name held for this server is let go. You can ask again at any time.
